issue_title: Confirm customer platform scope and missing evidence obligations

approach.summary: Record the exact customer platform promise for this delivery as `Windows x64 only` and map every non-Windows-x64 commitment to missing evidence, so platform expansion never happens implicitly.
rationale: The upstream analysis explicitly states the retained packaging and acceptance evidence is centered on Windows x64.
Platform scope is customer-facing and therefore had to be captured as a separate decision issue rather than buried in the bundle assembly step.
This gave the executor a bounded list of extra evidence obligations for every platform outside the now-recorded `Windows x64 only` promise.
non_goals: Do not attempt multi-platform build or packaging evidence work in this issue.
Do not change product/platform support policy outside the current customer-delivery context.
risk_controls: Force the decision record to distinguish `promised`, `best effort`, and `not included` platforms.
Tie every promised platform to either existing retained evidence or a concrete missing-evidence obligation.

tasks.title: Inventory current retained platform evidence
tasks.description: List the packaging, acceptance, and release evidence that currently supports Windows x64 delivery, and identify where evidence for any additional platform would need to come from.
acceptance: The current retained evidence set is summarized by platform.
Any non-Windows-x64 platform promise is shown as missing evidence rather than implied support.

tasks.title: Record the promised platform scope and evidence gaps
tasks.description: Write a platform-scope decision artifact that names the customer-promised platform list, marks unsupported or deferred platforms, and lists the exact evidence obligations for every platform that lacks retained evidence.
acceptance: The decision artifact explicitly names the promised platform scope.
Each platform outside the already-proven Windows x64 set has a concrete follow-up obligation or an explicit exclusion.

dependencies: Requires the same frozen baseline context as the shipment-mode decision.
Should reuse the formal-delivery caveats already captured in `UAN-nikostudio-formal-delivery-2026-04-09`.
conflict_risks: This issue intentionally overlaps the bundle wording because platform limitations must be reflected in customer-facing handoff notes.
